g.title: Architecture
g.text: Return to the three Part 1 sources. Create a separate four-source KB with Work IQ, without Fabric.
Orange dashed cards are the build target. Faded documents and services already exist. Fabric stays covered.
Arrows: caller to dependency. Responses return on the same connection.
Blue, solid: retrieve evidence / call the KB (REST or MCP)
Purple, solid: model call for planning / answer synthesis
Gray, dashed: sign-in, upload, embeddings or source data access
Orange: new build. Faded: reused. Covered: not used by this KB.
Logical lab architecture, not live status. Public endpoints, no VNet / private endpoints.
